description: Start a quick, anonymous pre-scan of a public website's home page: HTTP headers and HTML only, no real browser. Returns a preScanId to pass to get_prescan_result and a link to the report on cookieinspector.com. CookieInspector works alongside any consent platform; it checks what the banner actually does. Technical findings, not legal advice.

url.description: The website to check, e.g. example.com or https://example.com

name: prescan_site
title: Quick pre-scan of a website
